Bhaimarathī
prose work. not extant. mentioned by Patañjali in Mahābhāṣya, 4. 3. 87. See M. Krishnamachariar HCSL. Sn. 450.

Bhaimī
gr. by Bhīmasena. Oppert I. 3334. 4236. II. 2774.

Bhaimīpariṇaya
nāṭaka. Oppert I. 3441-42. 4337. 5749. 8148. II. 3742. 5344. 5973. 10406. Trav. Uni. 14278 A (inc.).
-C. Oppert I. 3443.
-C. by Veṅkaṭeśabhaṭṭa or Ślokakavi. Tirupati (RSVP). 2455 (inc.).

Bhaimīpariṇaya
or Nalavijaya by Rāmaśāstrin Maṇḍikal. A drama on the legend of Nala in 10 Acts.
Pt.. Govt. Branch Press, Mysore, 1914.

Bhaimīpariṇaya
or Bhaimīsvayaṃvara. in 6 acts by Śrīvatsa Śaṭhakopācārya, son of Cakravarti Śrīnivāsācārya. This drama was intended to be staged on the [Page237a] occasion of the festival of Padmāsahāya in the month of Caitra.
See M. Krishnamachariar, HCSL. Sn. 777; also see S. N. Dasgupta, HSL. Classical Period, I. p. 465 fn.
Adyar II. p. 29a. Adyar D. V. 1434. Govt. Or. Libr. Madras 63. MD. 12574-75. 18720. MT. 4038 (inc.). Mysore N. D. VIII. 27636. Extr. p. 326. 27637 (anukramaṇikā). PUL. II. p. 283.
Pt.. with C., Vāṇī Vilās Press, Srirangam, 1919.
